response.justification: The candidate is a strong and versatile full-stack engineer, but their profile does not match this role's core requirements. C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015 and a university thesis project, far short of the mandatory 5-10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. There is no Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was a Node/TypeScript role in a fintech-adjacent company, not capital markets systems), and no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle depth.
strengths: Solid systems-programming background via low-latency DLang work at Dunnhumby (async I/O, fibers, high-performance databases)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based development
Broad, adaptable technology experience with some CI/CD and DevOps tooling exposure
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience (~7 months, over a decade ago), versus a mandatory 5-10 years on Windows
No Fixed Income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle expertise; primarily MongoDB/MySQL background

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
Strong general engineering fundamentals and performance-oriented work
